method: PyMuPDF page-by-page extraction of three user-provided Vietnamese supplementary PDFs, without storing their textbook text
notes: All 556 pages have a nonempty selectable text layer; this does not mean every Japanese character, furigana, translation or grammar choice was extracted correctly.
Page 208 of the Kanji supplement contains no detectable Japanese codepoints in its text layer; it may be an index/end matter page and should be visually inspected.
Pages 85 and 185 of the grammar supplement and 208 of Kanji have fewer than 100 selectable text characters. Short pages are flagged for review, not automatically labeled missing lessons.
No copyrighted book passages or audio were uploaded to the public repository.
Full source coverage and 100% Japanese-Vietnamese accuracy remain unverified.
